From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual Action Plan — Close Velocity & Legal Gate

Hi Sarah — thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned on timing and responsibilities: 

Key points from the call:
- Target: NovusAI is aiming to sign by 2026-11-18 (legal/ procurement deadline you mentioned).
- Primary blockers: internal security questionnaire, PO approval, and legal review of data residency section.
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) with VPC peering.

Suggested mutual action plan (draft):
1) Week of Oct 19 — Security questionnaire sent and initial answers (owner: Novus procurement).
2) Oct 26 — Redwood provides SOC2 + architecture diagram + KMS integration notes (owner: Redwood: Ben).
3) Nov 2 — Legal markup window (Novus legal / Redwood legal).
4) Nov 9 — Final pricing and PO draft (owner: Novus finance).
5) Nov 16 — Exec signoff runway / signature at latest Nov 18 (target close date).

Dependencies / risks:
- If SOC2 evidence takes longer than 7 business days we need to push the legal window or plan for a short-term hosted trial to unblock dev work.
- PO cycles at Novus historically take ~2 weeks; procurement contact is looping in purchase approvals.

Attachments:
- I will send a one-page MAP (attached) with milestone owners and acceptance criteria after we confirm these dates.

Next steps / asks:
- Sarah: confirm the Nov 18 signature runway is still feasible given your internal approval cadence.
- Marissa / Sean: can you review the attached MAP and suggest any changes to owners or acceptance criteria?
- I'll follow up with a short HubSpot update and attach the MAP.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
